title: Zero-Shot Text-to-Image Generation
layout_note: Four equal square mask matrices in one row, each with a sub-caption (a)-(d) underneath; each matrix is a 22x22 cell grid (6 text tokens plus 16 image tokens) whose light cells are allowed attention and dark cells masked.
grouping: No frames or tints beyond the matrices themselves; the four panels are separated by whitespace and identified by their (a)-(d) sub-captions. Thicker grey grid lines inside each matrix mark the text/image boundary and image-row boundaries.
shapes_depth: Flat binary matrices: a cream fill for attended positions and a near-black navy fill for masked positions, with thin grey cell lines; no axes, labels or token names.
proposed_highlight: Nothing is highlighted beyond the pattern itself: each sparse-attention variant is told apart only by the shape of its cream band (diagonal stripe, comb, staircase, banded convolution) against the dark masked area.
lesson: Several attention-sparsity variants compare best as identical square binary matrices in a row, two flat colours only, so the reader's eye goes straight to the differences in the allowed band.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2102.12092); venue remembered as ICML 2021 (not printed on the arXiv v2 first page). DALL-E has no overview/architecture figure: Figure 1 shows dVAE reconstructions, Figure 4 gradient scaling in a resblock, Figure 10 a plain-box embedding scheme; Figure 11 (appendix) was chosen as the most instructive method-detail figure. Not a full-method figure. The four mask matrices are embedded raster images in the PDF, so kb measure counts them as photos (photo_share 0.968) and the palette covers only the remaining sub-caption text; the matrices' own two colours are cream and dark navy by eye.

arrangement.units: Four identical square matrices side by side, one per attention-mask variant, enclosed only by their own grid edges, each with an (a)-(d) sub-caption below.
arrangement.inputs_as: none drawn; the token sequence is implicit in the matrix rows and columns
arrangement.shared: the 6-token text block on the left of every matrix is identical across panels

taxonomy.task: sparse attention masks for an autoregressive text-to-image transformer

insights.structure: Four same-size square mask matrices in a single row, separated by whitespace, each with a lettered sub-caption beneath.
insights.data: Each mask is a binary grid of cream (attend) and dark navy (masked) cells, with thicker grid lines marking the text block and each image row.
insights.emphasis: Only the shape of the cream region changes between panels, so the variant's sparsity pattern is the sole thing that draws the eye.
insights.flow: Read panel by panel left to right; within a panel, the lower-left triangle shows causal order with no arrows.
insights.avoid: No axis labels mark which rows are text and which are image tokens, so the 6+16 split must be learned from the caption.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
